title: Trace requests with OpenTelemetry
prompt: Our platform team collects traces with OpenTelemetry. Turn on Inferlo's built-in OpenTelemetry tracing in src/app.ts using the @opentelemetry/api package, so every request to the app gets a server span named after its route and request logs carry the trace id. Do not add an OpenTelemetry SDK; the platform starts one before the app.
